The '''Mk 2e/W heavy blaster cannon''' was a type of heavy [[Blaster cannon/Legends|blaster cannon]]. Two were mounted on the turret of the [[HAVr A9 Floating Fortress/Legends|HAVr A9 Floating Fortress]].<ref name="MBC" />
